description: This PHP class 'TimezoneName' is an implementation of a validation rule within an API validator library, specifically checking if a given string is a valid timezone name.

classes.name: TimezoneName
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether a provided string is a valid timezone name.

methods.description: Validates whether the input is a string and a valid timezone name.
